title: Gottfried van Swieten (Bonn) to Count Cobenzl, 1757-59, three despatches with ciphered passages (ARA Brussels SEG 1236, DECODE R955-R957)

steps.what: DECODE R955-R957 fetched with the session cookie: 8 page images, 3 transcriptions.
Web search and local Tomokiyo/cryptiana copies for a printed decipherment.
R955: the clear lines under the numbers are the decipherment; aligned, they give an alphabetical syllabary (a 203, de 282, on 435, re 472...).
R955's values applied to the 1759 runs directly and linearly rescaled to 100-442.

Monotone-map annealer (msolve.py) onto a sorted inventory of French units, LM score + per-letter bonus; first runs collapsed onto repeated long words (no multiplicity cap) and a score bug (sum taken as mean).
Synthetic 274-group French text under a random alphabetical table: recovered verbatim once the 2-codes-per-unit cap and bonus 1.5 were set.
8 random starts on the 491 clean 1759 groups; seed 5 gave readable French (la nouvelle convention... souverainete... imperatrice), the others gibberish.
Four DECODE runs with dropped/doubled digits re-read from the images; a separate sign before run 1 dropped.
Seeded polish pass with enlarged inventory drifted to worse keys.
Key corrected by hand run by run against the surrounding clear French (magazins, Contades, Broglio, comte de Pergen); x 438/439, y 441, z 442 close the table.

outcome.method_basis: The 1759 alphabetical syllabary (R956, R957) was rebuilt by a monotone-map annealer from the ciphertext (seed 5 of 8 gave French), then corrected by hand against the clear French around each run; R955, a different 1757 table, was read from the decipherment written below its numbers.
outcome.notes: fraction_read = 1 - 21 unread of 553 groups in R956+R957; R955 read from its decipherment.

prior.where: R955 only: decipherment written on the page itself. R956/R957: none known, nothing in print.

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code with Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.
